description: A small, autonomous service implementing one business capability within a bounded context, deployed independently and owning its own data.
One deployable split into modules with enforced boundaries, the usual starting point from which a service is later extracted.
Services that share a database or must be deployed together, paying network costs without gaining independent deployment.
Data across services converges after a delay instead of being updated in one ACID transaction, so callers must tolerate stale reads and design compensation.
`AddStandardResilienceHandler` from `Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience`, which wraps an `HttpClient` in a rate limiter, total timeout, retry, circuit breaker and attempt timeout.
Frequent synchronous calls between two services, a sign that their functions belong in the same service.
